preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**4 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each test case has a valid integer N within the constraint 1 ≤ N ≤ 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(len(B) == N for N, B in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))
preconditions.description: Each test case's sequence B has exactly N elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= B[i] <= i+1 for i, B in enumerate([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))
preconditions.description: For each element B[i] in the sequence, 1 ≤ B[i] ≤ i+1 (since indices are 0-based in Python but 1-based in the problem).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line in ['YES', 'NO'] for stdout_line in [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_lines) == len(test_cases) for stdout_lines in [stdout.splitlines()] for test_cases in [[int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()]])
postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line == 'YES') == (all(B[i] == B[j] or math.gcd(B[i], B[j]) == B[i] == B[j] for i in range(N) for j in range(i+1, N)) and all(B[i] == B[j] or math.gcd(B[i], B[j]) == B[i] or math.gcd(B[i], B[j]) == B[j] for i in range(N) for j in range(i+1, N))) for N, B, stdout_line in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()], [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if the sequence B can be obtained from the initial sequence A by performing the allowed operations. This is true if and only if for every pair of elements in B, either they are equal or their GCD equals one of them (i.e., one divides the other).
